title: Rasmiy va norasmiy xat
goal_uz: Dars oxirida rasmiy shikoyat xati va do‘stingizga norasmiy elektron xatni to‘g‘ri tuzilishda, mos iboralar va abzatslar bilan yoza olasiz.

vocab.w: Looking forward to hearing from you

scenes.title: Rasmiy va norasmiy xat
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yangi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda eng kerakli o‘ttizta barqaror iborani o‘rgandik. Bugun ulardan yozuvda foydalanamiz. Rasmiy xat va norasmiy elektron xatning tuzilishini, ikkalasiga xos iboralarni, iltimos, shikoyat va minnatdorchilik bildirishni hamda matnni abzatslarga bo‘lishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida ikkala turdagi xatni ishonch bilan yoza olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we learned thirty useful fixed expressions. Today we will use them in writing. By the end, you will be able to write a polite formal letter and a friendly informal email.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar o‘ttizta foydali barqaror iborani o‘rgandik. Bugun ularni yozuvda qo‘llaymiz. Dars oxirida muloyim rasmiy xat va samimiy norasmiy elektron xat yoza olasiz.

scenes.title: Kimga yozyapsiz?
board: informal: friend, family, colleague you know
scenes.say_native: Har qanday xatni boshlashdan oldin ikki savolga javob bering: kimga yozyapman va nima uchun? Menejerga, kompaniyaga, notanish odamga yozsangiz, uslub rasmiy bo‘ladi. Do‘st, oila a’zosi yoki yaxshi tanish hamkasbga yozsangiz, norasmiy bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Before you write, ask two questions. Who am I writing to, and why? A manager or a company needs a formal style. A friend needs a relaxed one.
scenes.say_uz: Yozishdan oldin ikki savol bering. Kimga yozyapman va nima uchun? Menejer yoki kompaniyaga rasmiy uslub kerak. Do‘stga esa erkin uslub kerak.

scenes.title: Rasmiy xatning tuzilishi
scenes.say_native: Britaniyada rasmiy qog‘oz xat shunday tuziladi. Yuqori o‘ng burchakda sizning manzilingiz, uning ostida sana. Chap tomonda qabul qiluvchining ismi va manzili. Keyin murojaat, masalan “Dear Mr Hall”, so‘ng asosiy matn, yakunlovchi gap, xayrlashuv iborasi va imzo.
scenes.say: In a British formal letter, your address goes at the top right, with the date below it. The receiver's name and address go on the left. Then comes the greeting, the body, the closing line and your signature.
scenes.say_uz: Britaniya rasmiy xatida sizning manzilingiz yuqori o‘ngda, uning ostida sana turadi. Qabul qiluvchining ismi va manzili chapda. Keyin murojaat, asosiy matn, yakuniy gap va imzo keladi.

scenes.title: Rasmiy xat namunasi
board: I am writing to enquire about your English courses.
I would be grateful if you could send me the timetable.
scenes.say_native: Mana qisqa rasmiy xat namunasi. Birinchi gap yozishdan maqsadni darhol aytadi: “I am writing to enquire about…”. Ikkinchi gapda iltimos muloyim shaklda berilgan. Xat javob kutishni bildiruvchi yoki minnatdorchilik gapi bilan tugaydi.
scenes.say: Dear Mr Hall, I am writing to enquire about your English courses. I would be grateful if you could send me the timetable. Thank you for your help. Yours sincerely, Anna Reed.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli janob Xoll, men ingliz tili kurslaringiz haqida so‘rash uchun yozmoqdaman. Jadvalni yuborsangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim. Yordamingiz uchun rahmat. Hurmat bilan, Anna Rid.

scenes.title: Sincerely yoki faithfully?
board: Dear Sir or Madam → Yours faithfully

examples.t: Dear Sir or Madam, … Yours faithfully
examples.uz: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, … Hurmat bilan

scenes.say_native: Britaniya qoidasi oddiy. Agar kimligini bilsangiz va ismi bilan murojaat qilsangiz, “Dear Mr Hall” deb boshlab, “Yours sincerely” bilan tugatasiz. Agar ismini bilmasangiz, “Dear Sir or Madam” deb boshlab, “Yours faithfully” bilan tugatasiz.
scenes.say: If you know the name, begin with Dear Mr Hall and end with Yours sincerely. If you do not know the name, begin with Dear Sir or Madam and end with Yours faithfully.
scenes.say_uz: Ismni bilsangiz, Dear Mr Hall bilan boshlab, Yours sincerely bilan tugating. Ismni bilmasangiz, Dear Sir or Madam bilan boshlab, Yours faithfully bilan tugating.

scenes.title: Boshlanish va tugash mos kelmadi
board: ✗ Dear Sir or Madam … Yours sincerely
✓ Dear Sir or Madam … Yours faithfully
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato: murojaat va yakun mos kelmaydi. Ko‘pchilik “Dear Sir or Madam” deb boshlab, “Yours sincerely” bilan tugatadi. Bu noto‘g‘ri. Ism noma’lum bo‘lsa, faqat “Yours faithfully”. Yana bir xato: “Dear Mr Hall” dan keyin “Yours faithfully” yozish.
scenes.say: Be careful: Dear Sir or Madam goes with Yours faithfully, not Yours sincerely. And Dear Mr Hall goes with Yours sincerely. Match the beginning and the end.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtiyot bo‘ling: Dear Sir or Madam bilan Yours faithfully ishlatiladi, Yours sincerely emas. Dear Mr Hall bilan esa Yours sincerely. Boshlanish va tugashni moslang.

scenes.title: Yakunni tanlang
scenes.say_native: Uchta xat bor. Har birining oxirida qaysi iborani yozasiz: “Yours sincerely” yoki “Yours faithfully”? Birinchi xat Klark xonimga, ikkinchisi ismi noma’lum odamga, uchinchisi doktor Evansga. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Number one: Dear Mrs Clarke. Number two: Dear Sir or Madam. Number three: Dear Dr Evans. Which ending for each?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Dear Mrs Clarke. Ikkinchi: Dear Sir or Madam. Uchinchi: Dear Dr Evans. Har biriga qaysi yakun mos?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Klark xonimning ismi ma’lum, shuning uchun “Yours sincerely”. Ikkinchi: ism noma’lum, demak “Yours faithfully”. Uchinchi: doktor Evans, ya’ni familiya bor, shuning uchun “Yours sincerely”. Qoida shu: ism yoki unvon bilan familiya bo‘lsa, sincerely; hech narsa bo‘lmasa, faithfully.
scenes.say: One: Yours sincerely. Two: Yours faithfully. Three: Yours sincerely. A name means sincerely. No name means faithfully.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Yours sincerely. Ikki: Yours faithfully. Uch: Yours sincerely. Ism bo‘lsa sincerely. Ism bo‘lmasa faithfully.

scenes.title: Norasmiy elektron xat
board: Opening: Thanks for your email! / How are you?
Closing: Write soon! · Best wishes · Love · Cheers

examples.t: Hi Anna, thanks for your message!

examples.uz: Tezroq yoz! Seni yaxshi ko‘ruvchi Tom

scenes.say_native: Do‘stga yozilgan xatda manzil va sana kerak emas. Faqat “Hi Anna” yoki “Dear Anna” bilan boshlaysiz. Ochilish gapi samimiy: “Thanks for your email” yoki “How are you?”. Yakunda “Best wishes”, “All the best”, “Love” yoki Britaniyada “Cheers” ishlatiladi. “Love” faqat yaqin odamlarga.
scenes.say: A message to a friend is simpler. Start with Hi Anna, open warmly with Thanks for your email, and close with Best wishes, All the best or Love. Cheers is common in British English.
scenes.say_uz: Do‘stga xat oddiyroq. Hi Anna bilan boshlang, Thanks for your email bilan iliq ochilang va Best wishes, All the best yoki Love bilan tugating. Cheers Britaniyada keng tarqalgan.

scenes.title: Unvonlar va ishchi elektron xat
scenes.say_native: Unvonlar: “Mr” erkak uchun, “Mrs” turmushga chiqqan ayol uchun, “Ms” esa oilaviy holati noma’lum yoki ahamiyatsiz bo‘lganda ayollarga ishlatiladi, shuning uchun u xavfsiz tanlov. Britaniyada nuqtasiz yoziladi, Amerikada nuqta bilan.
scenes.say: Use Ms when you are not sure about a woman's marital status. In British English there is no full stop after Mr or Mrs. In an email, always write a short, clear subject line.
scenes.say_uz: Ayolning oilaviy holatini bilmasangiz, Ms ishlating. Britaniya inglizchasida Mr yoki Mrs dan keyin nuqta qo‘yilmaydi. Elektron xatda doim qisqa va aniq mavzu yozing.

scenes.title: Ibora juftliklari
board: I am writing to inform you ↔ Just a quick note to say
I would like to know ↔ I wanted to ask
I look forward to hearing from you ↔ Write back soon!

examples.t: I would like to enquire about the price.
Can you tell me the price?

scenes.say_native: Endi iboralar. Rasmiy uslub to‘liq va muloyim shakllarni yaxshi ko‘radi: “I am writing to inform you”, “I would like to enquire”, “I look forward to hearing from you”. Norasmiy uslub esa qisqa va jonli: “Just a quick note”, “I wanted to ask”, “Write back soon”. Mazmun bir xil, ohang boshqacha.
scenes.say: Formal English uses full, polite forms: I am writing to inform you, I would like to enquire. Informal English is shorter and warmer: Just a quick note, I wanted to ask, Write back soon.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy ingliz tili to‘liq va muloyim shakllarni ishlatadi. Norasmiy ingliz tili qisqaroq va iliqroq.

scenes.title: So‘z tanlash va qisqartmalar
board: informal: get in touch · ask for · get · help
formal: no contractions → I am, I would, do not

examples.uz: Iltimos, men bilan elektron pochta orqali bog‘laning.

examples.t: Get in touch if you need help.

scenes.say_native: Rasmiy yozuvda ko‘pincha lotin ildizli bitta so‘z ishlatiladi: “contact”, “request”, “receive”. Norasmiy yozuvda esa frazali fe’llar: “get in touch”, “ask for”, “get”. Ikkinchi farq: qisqartmalar. Norasmiy xatda “I’m”, “don’t”, “can’t” tabiiy.
scenes.say: Formal writing prefers single words such as contact, request and receive, and avoids contractions. Informal writing likes phrasal verbs such as get in touch and ask for, and contractions are natural.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy yozuv contact, request, receive kabi bitta so‘zlarni afzal ko‘radi va qisqartmalardan qochadi. Norasmiy yozuv get in touch, ask for kabi frazali fe’llarni yaxshi ko‘radi.

scenes.title: O‘zbek tili bilan taqqoslash
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada hurmatni “siz” va “sen” ko‘rsatadi, xatda esa “Hurmatli” deb boshlaymiz. Inglizchada faqat bitta “you” bor, shuning uchun hurmat boshqa vositalar bilan beriladi: “Would you”, “Could you”, “I would be grateful if”, “please” va to‘liq gaplar.
scenes.say: English has only one word for you, so politeness comes from other things. Could you help me is more polite than Can you help me. Would you mind and I would be grateful if are even more formal.
scenes.say_uz: Inglizchada you bitta, shuning uchun muloyimlik boshqa vositalardan keladi. Could you help me, Can you help me dan muloyimroq.

scenes.title: Uslublar aralashib ketdi
board: ✗ Dear Sir, I wanna complain about the stuff.
✓ Dear Sir, I would like to complain about the goods.
✗ Hi, I do not know you but I need help.
✓ Dear Ms Hall, I am writing to ask for your help.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir odatiy xato: bitta xatda uslublar aralashadi. “Dear Sir” deb boshlab, keyin “wanna”, “stuff”, “guys” deb yozish. Yoki do‘stga juda rasmiy “I am writing to inform you…” deb yozish. O‘zbek tilida biz ba’zan og‘zaki so‘zni yozuvga olib kiramiz.
scenes.say: Do not mix styles. Dear Sir, I wanna complain about the stuff sounds wrong. Write: I would like to complain about the goods. Keep the same style from start to finish.
scenes.say_uz: Uslublarni aralashtirmang. Dear Sir, I wanna complain about the stuff noto‘g‘ri eshitiladi. To‘g‘risi: I would like to complain about the goods. Boshidan oxirigacha bir uslubda yozing.

scenes.title: Rasmiylashtiring
board: 1) Can you send me the price list?
3) Tell me when you can come.
scenes.say_native: Uchta norasmiy gapni rasmiy qiling. Birinchi: “Can you send me the price list?”. Ikkinchi: “I’m writing to say sorry”. Uchinchi: “Tell me when you can come”. “Could you”, “I am writing to apologise” va “Please let me know” kabi shakllarni ishlating. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Make these formal. One: Can you send me the price list? Two: I'm writing to say sorry. Three: Tell me when you can come.
scenes.say_uz: Buni rasmiy qiling. Bir: Can you send me the price list? Ikki: I'm writing to say sorry. Uch: Tell me when you can come.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Could you please send me the price list?
3) Please let me know when you are able to come.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Could you please send me the price list?”. Ikkinchi: “I am writing to apologise”, bunda “I’m” to‘liq yozildi va “say sorry” o‘rniga “apologise” keldi. Uchinchi: “Please let me know when you are able to come”. Ko‘rdingizmi, qisqartma yo‘qoldi, “please” qo‘shildi, “can” o‘rniga “could” yoki “be able to” keldi.
scenes.say: One: Could you please send me the price list? Two: I am writing to apologise. Three: Please let me know when you are able to come.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Price list yuborsangiz bo‘ladimi? Ikki: Uzr so‘rash uchun yozmoqdaman. Uch: Qachon kela olishingizni ma’lum qiling.

scenes.title: Iltimos qilish
board: I would be grateful if you could…
Could you possibly…? · Would you mind -ing…?

examples.t: I would be grateful if you could confirm the date.
Would you mind sending me the details?

scenes.say_native: Iltimos qilishning rasmiy shakllari: “I would be grateful if you could…”, bunda “could” doim o‘tgan zamon shaklida turadi va muloyimlikni bildiradi. “Would you mind” dan keyin fe’lga -ing qo‘shiladi: “Would you mind sending”. “I would like to request” esa rasmiyroq va ko‘pincha tashkilotlarga yoziladi.
scenes.say: For polite requests, use I would be grateful if you could, Could you possibly, or Would you mind sending. After Would you mind, use the ing form.
scenes.say_uz: Muloyim iltimos uchun I would be grateful if you could, Could you possibly yoki Would you mind sending ishlating. Would you mind dan keyin -ing shakli keladi.

scenes.title: Shikoyat qilish

examples.t: I am writing to complain about the service.
examples.uz: Xizmat ustidan shikoyat qilish uchun yozmoqdaman.

examples.t: I would appreciate a full refund.

scenes.say_native: Shikoyat xati to‘rt qismdan iborat. Birinchi: nima uchun yozayotganingiz. Ikkinchi: nima sodir bo‘lgani, sana va faktlar bilan. Uchinchi: sizdan nima kutayotganingiz, masalan pulni qaytarish yoki almashtirish. To‘rtinchi: muloyim yakun. Ohang qat’iy bo‘lsin, lekin haqoratsiz.
scenes.say: A complaint has four parts: why you are writing, what happened, what you want, and a polite ending. Be firm but never rude. Facts are stronger than angry words.
scenes.say_uz: Shikoyat to‘rt qismdan iborat: nima uchun yozyapsiz, nima bo‘ldi, nima istaysiz va muloyim yakun. Qat’iy bo‘ling, lekin qo‘pol bo‘lmang.

scenes.title: Qo‘pol shikoyat
board: ✗ Your hotel is terrible! Give me my money!
✓ I was disappointed with the room and I would appreciate a refund.
✓ I would be grateful if you could…
scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchilik shikoyatda jahl bilan yozadi: “Your hotel is terrible, give me my money”. Bunday xatni kompaniya ko‘pincha jiddiy qabul qilmaydi. Samarali shikoyatda aniq muammo, sana va talab bo‘ladi, ohang esa muloyim: “I was disappointed with the room”, “I would appreciate a refund”.
scenes.say: Do not write: Your hotel is terrible, give me my money. Write: I was disappointed with the room, and I would appreciate a refund. Polite language gets better results.
scenes.say_uz: Yozmang: Mehmonxonangiz dahshat, pulimni bering. Yozing: Xonadan xafa bo‘ldim va pul qaytarilsa minnatdor bo‘lardim. Muloyim til yaxshiroq natija beradi.

scenes.title: Shikoyat xatini tartiblang
board: A) I would like a refund.
B) I am writing to complain about my order.
C) The jacket arrived torn on 3 May.
D) I look forward to your reply.
scenes.say_native: Shikoyat xatining to‘rt gapi aralashib ketgan. Ularni to‘g‘ri tartibga qo‘ying. Eslang: avval maqsad, keyin nima bo‘lgani, keyin talab, oxirida yakun. Harflarni tartib bilan ayting, masalan B, keyin qaysi biri.
scenes.say: A: I would like a refund. B: I am writing to complain about my order. C: The jacket arrived torn on the third of May. D: I look forward to your reply. Put them in order.
scenes.say_uz: A: Pul qaytarilishini istayman. B: Buyurtmam ustidan shikoyat qilish uchun yozmoqdaman. C: Kurtka 3-mayda yirtilgan holda keldi. D: Javobingizni kutaman. Tartibga soling.

scenes.title: Javob: B, C, A, D
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: B, C, A, D. Avval B: “I am writing to complain about my order”, bu maqsad. Keyin C: kurtka 3-mayda yirtilgan holda kelgani, bu fakt. Keyin A: pul qaytarish talabi. Oxirida D: “I look forward to your reply”, bu muloyim yakun.
scenes.say: The order is B, C, A, D. First the reason, then the facts, then the request, and finally a polite ending.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri tartib B, C, A, D. Avval maqsad, keyin faktlar, keyin talab va nihoyat muloyim yakun.

scenes.title: Minnatdorchilik bildirish
board: formal: I would like to thank you for…
formal: I am extremely grateful for…
informal: Thanks a lot for…! · It was so kind of you.

examples.t: Thank you for your prompt reply.
Thanks so much for the lovely present!

scenes.say_native: Rahmat aytish ham uslubga qarab o‘zgaradi. Rasmiy xatda: “I would like to thank you for…” yoki “I am extremely grateful for…”. “Thank you for your prompt reply” ish yozishmasida juda keng tarqalgan. Do‘stga: “Thanks a lot for…”, “Thanks so much for the lovely present”, “It was so kind of you”.
scenes.say: Formal thanks: I would like to thank you for your help. Informal thanks: Thanks so much for the lovely present! After thank you for, use a noun or the ing form.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy rahmat: I would like to thank you for your help. Norasmiy rahmat: Thanks so much for the lovely present! Thank you for dan keyin ot yoki -ing keladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: mehmonxona haqida suhbat
board: Q1: What was wrong with the room?
scenes.say_native: Endi tinglash vaqti. Ikki hamkasb, Ella va Mark, mehmonxonaga yoziladigan shikoyat xati haqida gaplashmoqda. Matnni diqqat bilan tinglang. Ikki savolga javob toping: xonada nimasi yomon edi va Ella nimani istaydi? Matnni bir marta tinglaysiz, shuning uchun muhim tafsilotlarni eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Mark, I'm writing to the hotel. The room was freezing, because the heating didn't work for two nights. Are you going to ask for your money back? Not all of it. I'd like a refund for two nights, and a written apology. That sounds fair. Start politely, though.
scenes.say_uz: Mark, men mehmonxonaga yozyapman. Xona muzdek edi, chunki isitish ikki kecha ishlamadi. Pulingni qaytarishni so‘raysanmi? Hammasini emas. Ikki kecha uchun pul va yozma uzr istayman. Bu adolatli eshitiladi. Lekin muloyim boshla.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: Q1: What was wrong with the room?
Q3: What advice does Mark give?
scenes.say_native: Savollar sizga ma’lum. Birinchi: xonada nima yomon edi? Ikkinchi: Ella nimani xohlaydi? Uchinchi: Mark qanday maslahat berdi? Dialogni xotirangizdan eslang va javoblarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Question one: what was wrong with the room? Question two: what does Ella want? Question three: what advice does Mark give?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: xonada nima yomon edi? Ikki: Ella nimani istaydi? Uch: Mark qanday maslahat beradi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 1) The heating didn't work for two nights.
2) A refund for two nights and an apology.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: isitish ikki kecha ishlamagan, xona muzdek bo‘lgan. Ikkinchi: Ella ikki kecha uchun pulni qaytarish va yozma uzr so‘rashni xohlaydi. Uchinchi: Mark xatni muloyim boshlashni maslahat beradi. E’tibor bering, Ella hamma pulni emas, faqat shikoyatga mos qismini so‘radi.
scenes.say: The heating did not work for two nights. Ella wants a refund for two nights and a written apology. Mark advises her to start politely.
scenes.say_uz: Isitish ikki kecha ishlamadi. Ella ikki kecha uchun pul va yozma uzr istaydi. Mark muloyim boshlashni maslahat beradi.

scenes.title: Abzatslarga bo‘lish
board: leave a blank line between paragraphs
scenes.say_native: Endi abzatslar. Qoida: bitta abzats, bitta g‘oya. Rasmiy xat odatda to‘rt qismdan iborat: ochilish, tafsilot, talab va yakun. Abzatslar orasida bo‘sh qator qoldiring yoki inglizcha yozuvda ko‘pincha abzats boshini ichkariga suramiz. Katta bir blokdagi matn o‘qishni qiyinlashtiradi.
scenes.say: One idea belongs in one paragraph. A good formal letter has an opening, the details, the request and an ending. Leave a clear space between paragraphs.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta g‘oya bitta abzatsga tegishli. Yaxshi rasmiy xatda ochilish, tafsilot, talab va yakun bo‘ladi. Abzatslar orasida bo‘sh joy qoldiring.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchi so‘zlar
board: formal: Firstly · In addition · However · Therefore · Finally
informal: Anyway · By the way · Also · So

examples.t: By the way, did you get my text?

scenes.say_native: Abzatslar o‘zaro bog‘lovchi so‘zlar bilan ulanadi. Rasmiy xatda: “Firstly”, “In addition”, “However”, “Therefore”, “Finally”. Bular qo‘shish, qarama-qarshilik va natijani bildiradi. Norasmiy xatda: “Anyway”, “By the way”, “Also”, “So”. Masalan, mavzuni o‘zgartirayotganda “By the way” deymiz.
scenes.say: Link your ideas. In formal letters use Firstly, In addition, However, Therefore and Finally. In friendly emails, use Anyway, By the way, Also and So.
scenes.say_uz: G‘oyalaringizni bog‘lang. Rasmiy xatda Firstly, In addition, However, Therefore, Finally ishlating. Samimiy xatda Anyway, By the way, Also, So.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchi va abzats xatolari
scenes.say_native: Ikki odatiy xato. Birinchisi: butun xat bitta uzun blokda yozilgan. O‘quvchi nima muhimligini topa olmaydi. Ikkinchisi: bog‘lovchidan keyin vergulni tushirib qoldirish: “However I was disappointed”. To‘g‘risi “However, I was disappointed”. Yana bir xato: “but” va “however”ni bir gapda aralashtirish.
scenes.say: Avoid one long block of text. Divide the letter into short paragraphs. And remember the comma: However, I was disappointed.
scenes.say_uz: Uzun bitta blokdan qoching. Xatni qisqa abzatslarga bo‘ling. Va vergulni unutmang: However, I was disappointed.

scenes.title: Gaplarni abzatslarga ajrating
board: 1) I booked a table for six.
scenes.say_native: Bu gaplar restoranga yozilgan shikoyatdan olingan. Qaysi biri ochilish, qaysi biri tafsilot, qaysi biri talab va qaysi biri yakun abzatsiga tegishli? Raqamlarni mos qismlarga ayting. Eslang: ochilish, tafsilot, talab, yakun.
scenes.say: Which sentence is the opening, which is the detail, which is the request, and which is the ending? One: I booked a table for six. Two: We waited forty minutes. Three: I would like an apology. Four: Thank you for your attention.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi gap ochilish, qaysi tafsilot, qaysi talab va qaysi yakun? Bir: Olti kishilik stol band qildim. Ikki: Qirq daqiqa kutdik. Uch: Uzr kutaman. To‘rt: E’tiboringiz uchun rahmat.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gap, “I booked a table for six”, ochilishga mos: nima haqida ekani aytiladi. Ikkinchi, “We waited forty minutes”, tafsilot, ya’ni muammoning o‘zi. Uchinchi, “I would like an apology”, talab. To‘rtinchi, “Thank you for your attention”, yakun.
scenes.say: One is the opening. Two is the detail. Three is the request. Four is the ending.
scenes.say_uz: Bir ochilish. Ikki tafsilot. Uch talab. To‘rt yakun.

scenes.title: To‘liq shikoyat xati
board: I am writing to complain about my order no. 4521.
The jacket arrived torn. I would appreciate a full refund.
scenes.say_native: Endi hammasini birlashtirgan xat. Ismi noma’lum odamga yozilgani uchun “Dear Sir or Madam” va “Yours faithfully”. Birinchi abzats maqsadni aytadi. Ikkinchi abzats muammo va talabni beradi. Gaplarning hammasi to‘liq, qisqartmasiz va muloyim. Hech qanday haqorat yo‘q, lekin ohang qat’iy.
scenes.say: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about my order number 4521. The jacket arrived torn on the third of May, and I would appreciate a full refund. I look forward to your reply. Yours faithfully, Dina Rahimova.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, 4521-buyurtmam ustidan shikoyat qilish uchun yozmoqdaman. Kurtka 3-mayda yirtilgan holda keldi, to‘liq pul qaytarilsa minnatdor bo‘lardim. Javobingizni kutaman. Hurmat bilan, Dina Rahimova.

scenes.title: Norasmiy elektron xat
board: Thanks for the lovely weekend! Sorry I left in a hurry.
Anyway, are you free on Friday?
scenes.say_native: Mana norasmiy elektron xat namunasi. Salomlashuv “Hi Ben”. Birinchi gapda rahmat va uzr, shundan keyin “Anyway” bilan yangi mavzuga o‘tamiz. Qisqartmalar bor: “I’m”, “aren’t”. Xat qisqa va iliq, oxirida “Cheers”. Bu xatni do‘stingizga yozasiz, shuning uchun “I look forward to hearing from you” juda rasmiy bo‘lardi, “Write back soon” esa joyida.
scenes.say: Hi Ben, thanks for the lovely weekend! Sorry I left in a hurry. Anyway, are you free on Friday? Let me know. Cheers, Tom.
scenes.say_uz: Salom Ben, ajoyib dam olish kunlari uchun rahmat! Shoshilib ketganim uchun uzr. Aytgancha, juma kuni bo‘shmisan? Menga xabar ber. Salomat bo‘l, Tom.

scenes.title: Rasmiy yoki norasmiy?
board: 2) I enclose a copy of my CV.
4) I would be grateful for a prompt reply.
scenes.say_native: Mana to‘rtta gap. Har birini o‘qing va qaysi uslubga tegishli ekanini ayting: rasmiy yoki norasmiy. Gapning ohangi va so‘zlariga, qisqartmalarga e’tibor bering. Raqamni va uslubni aytib chiqing, masalan, bir, norasmiy.
scenes.say: Formal or informal? One: Hope you're well! Chat soon. Two: I enclose a copy of my CV. Three: I'm really sorry about Friday! Four: I would be grateful for a prompt reply.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiymi yoki norasmiymi? Bir: Yaxshi yurgan bo‘lsang kerak! Tez orada gaplashamiz. Ikki: Rezyumemning nusxasini ilova qilaman. Uch: Juma kuni uchun juda uzr! To‘rt: Tezkor javob bersangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi norasmiy: “Hope you’re well” va “Chat soon” qisqa va samimiy. Ikkinchi rasmiy: “I enclose” ish xatlarida ilova haqida aytiladi. Uchinchi norasmiy: qisqartma “I’m” va “really”. To‘rtinchi rasmiy: “I would be grateful” va “prompt reply”.
scenes.say: One is informal. Two is formal. Three is informal. Four is formal. Contractions and short phrases usually mean informal style.
scenes.say_uz: Bir norasmiy. Ikki rasmiy. Uch norasmiy. To‘rt rasmiy. Qisqartmalar va qisqa iboralar odatda norasmiy uslubni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: taklifga javob
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. Zara va Leo do‘stlar. Zara kechki ovqatga taklif olgan, lekin borolmaydi va elektron xat yozishi kerak. Leo unga maslahat beradi. Tinglang va ikki savolga javob toping: Zaraning muammosi nima va Leo nimani taklif qiladi?
scenes.say: Leo, Jack invited me to dinner on Saturday, but I have a family wedding. What should I write? Just be honest. Say thank you, explain why you can't come, and suggest meeting next week. Good idea. Should I write Dear Jack? No, Hi Jack is fine. You're friends.
scenes.say_uz: Leo, Jek meni shanba kuni kechki ovqatga taklif qildi, lekin menda oilaviy to‘y bor. Nima yozay? Shunchaki rostini ayt. Rahmat de, nega kela olmasligingni tushuntir va kelasi hafta uchrashishni taklif qil. Yaxshi fikr. Dear Jack deb yozaymi? Yo‘q, Hi Jack yetarli. Sizlar do‘stsizlar.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
scenes.say_native: Uch savol. Birinchi: Zaraning muammosi nima? Ikkinchi: Leo nimani maslahat beradi? Uchinchi: xatni qanday boshlashi kerak: Dear Jack yoki Hi Jack? Xotirangizdan javob bering.
scenes.say: Question one: what is Zara's problem? Question two: what does Leo suggest? Question three: how should she begin the email?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Zaraning muammosi nima? Ikki: Leo nimani maslahat beradi? Uch: xatni qanday boshlashi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) She has a family wedding on Saturday.
2) Thank him, explain, suggest next week.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Zarada shanba kuni oilaviy to‘y bor, shuning uchun taklifni qabul qila olmaydi. Ikkinchi: Leo minnatdorchilik bildirish, sababni tushuntirish va kelasi hafta uchrashishni taklif qilishni maslahat beradi. Uchinchi: “Hi Jack”.
scenes.say: Zara has a family wedding on Saturday. Leo suggests thanking Jack, explaining, and offering next week. She should start with Hi Jack.
scenes.say_uz: Zarada shanba kuni oilaviy to‘y bor. Leo Jekka rahmat aytish, tushuntirish va kelasi haftani taklif qilishni maslahat beradi. Hi Jack bilan boshlashi kerak.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: muloyim intonatsiya
scenes.say_native: Xatni yozasiz, lekin ko‘pincha uni ovoz chiqarib ham o‘qiysiz yoki telefonda aytasiz. Tez gapirishda “could you” birikmasi “kudja” kabi eshitiladi, “would you” esa “wudja”. Bu bog‘lanish tabiiy nutqning belgisi. Iltimosni aytganda ovoz oxirida yengil ko‘tariladi va “please” bilan yumshaydi.
scenes.say: When we speak quickly, could you sounds like couldja, and would you sounds like wouldja. In writing, always write the full words. In a polite request, let your voice rise gently.
scenes.say_uz: Tez gapirganda could you couldja kabi, would you wouldja kabi eshitiladi. Yozuvda doim to‘liq yozing. Muloyim iltimosda ovozingiz yengil ko‘tarilsin.

scenes.title: Ilova va javob iboralari
board: I am attaching… / I enclose… (paper letter)
Re: = about · Thank you in advance

examples.t: Thank you in advance for your help.

scenes.say_native: Elektron xatda ilova haqida aytish uchun rasmiy shakl: “Please find attached…”. Do‘stga esa “I’m attaching…” yoki “Here’s the file”. Qog‘oz xatda ilova uchun “I enclose” ishlatiladi. Mavzu qatoridagi “Re:” so‘zi “haqida” degan ma’noni bildiradi va javob yozilganda ham qo‘shiladi.
scenes.say: For an email attachment in a formal message, write Please find attached. For a paper letter, write I enclose. Re in a subject line means about.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy elektron xatda ilova uchun Please find attached yozing. Qog‘oz xatda I enclose. Mavzudagi Re haqida degan ma’noni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Tekshirish ro‘yxati
board: Style: same from start to finish?
scenes.say_native: Xatni yuborishdan oldin to‘rt narsani tekshiring. Birinchi: uslub boshidan oxirigacha bir xilmi? Ikkinchi: murojaat va yakun mosmi, ya’ni “Dear Mr Hall” va “Yours sincerely”? Uchinchi: sana, ism va raqamlar to‘g‘rimi? To‘rtinchi: imlo, vergul va nuqtalar.
scenes.say: Before you send, check four things: the style, the greeting and ending, the facts, and the spelling. Read your letter aloud once. You will hear many mistakes.
scenes.say_uz: Yuborishdan oldin to‘rt narsani tekshiring: uslub, murojaat va yakun, faktlar hamda imlo. Xatni bir marta ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Ko‘p xatolarni eshitasiz.

scenes.title: Yozishga tayyorlanish
board: Task: formal email to a language school
Reason: your course book is missing
scenes.say_native: Endi mustaqil vazifa. Til maktabiga rasmiy xat yozasiz: darslik yetib kelmagan. Avval rejani ovoz chiqarib ayting. Birinchi gapingiz nima bo‘ladi? Murojaat qanday? Yakun qanday? Har bir abzats uchun bittadan gap o‘ylang, so‘ng o‘z daftaringizga to‘liq yozing.
scenes.say: Plan an email to a language school. Your course book has not arrived. Say your opening sentence aloud. Then say your request and your closing line.
scenes.say_uz: Til maktabiga xat rejalashtiring. Darsligingiz kelmagan. Ochilish gapini ovoz chiqarib ayting. Keyin iltimos va yakun gapini ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I am writing because my course book has not arrived.
I would be grateful if you could send it this week.

examples.t: I look forward to hearing from you.

scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. Ism noma’lum, shuning uchun “Dear Sir or Madam” va “Yours faithfully”. Ochilish: “I am writing because my course book has not arrived”. Tafsilot: “I ordered it on 2 October”. Talab: “I would be grateful if you could send it this week”. Yakun: “I look forward to hearing from you”.
scenes.say: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing because my course book has not arrived. I ordered it on the second of October. I would be grateful if you could send it this week. I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, darsligim kelmagani uchun yozmoqdaman. Men uni 2-oktyabrda buyurtma qilganman. Uni shu hafta yuborsangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim. Javobingizni kutaman. Hurmat bilan.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Formal: Dear Mr Hall → Yours sincerely
Dear Sir or Madam → Yours faithfully
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: xatdan oldin kimga va nima uchun yozayotganingizni aniqlang. Ikkinchi: ism bilan murojaatga sincerely, ismsiz murojaatga faithfully mos keladi. Uchinchi: iltimos, shikoyat va minnatdorchilikni uslubga mos iboralar bilan bildiring. To‘rtinchi: xatni abzatslarga bo‘ling va bog‘lovchilarni ishlating. Beshinchi: yuborishdan oldin tekshirib chiqing. Yaxshi xat nafaqat grammatikaga, balki to‘g‘ri ohangga ham tayanadi.
scenes.say: Today you learned how to choose a style, set out a letter, make polite requests, complain and thank in writing, and organise paragraphs. Well done!
scenes.say_uz: Bugun uslub tanlashni, xat tuzilishini, muloyim iltimos qilishni, yozma shikoyat va minnatdorchilik bildirishni va abzatslarni o‘rgandingiz. Barakalla!

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: 2) an informal email to a friend
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: ikkita matn yozing, har biri taxminan yuz yigirma so‘zdan iborat bo‘lsin. Birinchisi rasmiy shikoyat xati, ikkinchisi do‘stingizga norasmiy elektron xat. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: rasmiy xatda murojaat va yakun mos, ohang muloyim, kamida uchta abzats bor; norasmiy xatda esa qisqartmalar va samimiy iboralar ishlatilgan. Keyingi darsda o‘qishni o‘rganamiz: matnning asosiy g‘oyasini topish.
scenes.say: For homework, write two texts of about one hundred and twenty words each: a formal complaint and an informal email. Next time we will practise finding the main idea of a text.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: har biri taxminan yuz yigirma so‘zdan iborat ikkita matn yozing: rasmiy shikoyat va norasmiy elektron xat. Keyingi darsda matnning asosiy g‘oyasini topishni mashq qilamiz.

homework_uz: Ikkita matn yozing, har biri taxminan 120 so‘z: rasmiy shikoyat xati va do‘stingizga norasmiy elektron xat. Rasmiy xatda murojaat va yakun mos bo‘lsin, kamida uchta abzats va muloyim ohang bo‘lsin. Norasmiy xatda qisqartmalar va samimiy iboralar ishlating. Keyingi darsda o‘qishda asosiy g‘oyani topishni o‘rganamiz.

quiz.q: You write 'Dear Sir or Madam'. Which ending is correct?
quiz.why_uz: Ism noma’lum bo‘lsa, Britaniya qoidasi bo‘yicha Yours faithfully ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: You write 'Dear Mr Hall'. Which ending is correct?
quiz.why_uz: Ism bilan murojaatdan keyin Yours sincerely keladi.

quiz.q: Which sentence is the most formal?
options: Can you send the price list?
I would be grateful if you could send the price list.
quiz.why_uz: I would be grateful if you could… eng muloyim va rasmiy shakl.

options: Would you mind to send me the details?
Would you mind sending me the details?
Would you mind send me the details?
Would you mind sent me the details?
quiz.why_uz: Would you mind dan keyin fe’lga -ing qo‘shiladi.

quiz.q: Which is best for a formal complaint?
options: You must give me my money!
I was disappointed with the service and I would appreciate a refund.
quiz.why_uz: Shikoyat qat’iy, lekin muloyim va aniq bo‘lishi kerak.

quiz.q: Which is the correct order of a complaint?
quiz.why_uz: Avval sabab, keyin faktlar, talab va yakun.
However jumla boshida bo‘lsa, undan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi.

quiz.q: Which phrase belongs in an informal email?
options: I look forward to hearing from you.
Anyway, are you free on Friday?
quiz.why_uz: Anyway norasmiy xatda mavzuni o‘zgartirish uchun ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: You do not know if a woman is married. Which title is best?
quiz.why_uz: Ms oilaviy holat noma’lum bo‘lganda xavfsiz tanlov.
Thank you for dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi: Thank you for helping me.
